MFSTNet · lane placement · 19 Aug 2026

Place The Lanes

The heat shows where vehicles actually were, over 30 sampled frames. Put one cross on each approach. Two clicks a camera. The crosses start on the automatic guess, so most cameras only need confirming or nudging.

Why by hand

  1. Measured: automatic centres move 0.164 of the frame width — about 315 px — when the detector changes. A lane that moves when the tooling changes is not a property of the road.
  2. The heat map is the aid, not the authority: it shows where the detector saw traffic, and on dense Indian scenes the detector misses a lot. Place the cross where the approach is, not where the heat is.
  3. Order does not matter — lanes are renamed left-to-right on import.
  4. When you are done, Save writes lane_centres.json, or Copy puts it on the clipboard to paste back.
